response.text:
India mein acne aur oily skin ke liye ₹700 ke andar kai behtareen serums available hain. Aapki skin ki zarurat ke hisaab se (jaise active acne ke liye Salicylic Acid ya daag-dhabbe hatane ke liye Niacinamide) aap inme se ek chun sakte hain:

Ye Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum pores ko saaf karne aur **blackheads, whiteheads aur active breakouts** ko theek karne ke liye sabse best hai.

Yeh The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum **acne aur daag dono** par ek sath asar karta hai kyunki isme Salicylic Acid aur Niacinamide dono ka combination hai.

Yeh Dot & Key 2% Salicylic Cica Anti Acne Serum sensitive aur acne-prone skin ke liye acha hai kyunki isme **Cica aur Salicylic Acid** milkar skin ki jalan ko shant karte hain.

Agar aapke chehre par active pimples kam hain aur **purane daag-dhabbe (acne marks)** zyada hain, toh Plum 10% Niacinamide Face Serum with Rice Water ek behtareen aur budget-friendly choice hai.
